scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the next two unreviewed NVIDIA sources. This is not execution evidence or a permanent exclusion.
linked_reference_caveat: Only these two complete original bodies were reviewed. Linked payloads, deployment references, component skills, schemas, helper implementations, licenses and concrete input evidence require separate review. Source claims are not measured execution results.

sources.workflow: Select the actual retrieval or generation starter, prepare a matching payload, check authorized deployed storage and workflow readiness, submit once only when requested, monitor the same run to a terminal state, and inspect retained outputs. The original separately permits payload-only requests without cluster access or submission.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Payload preparation needs the matching starter and versioned payload guidance, actual storage paths and retrieval or generation intent. Real runs additionally need the matching deployed Airflow workflow, controller storage mappings and access, prepared source and query videos, GPU capacity and shared FFmpeg. WSM generation additionally requires aligned prepared controls. Azure support requires documented deployment and code changes, not prefix substitution. Credentials belong outside payloads. Complete declared CC-BY-4.0 and Apache-2.0 terms and actual input permissions remain to be checked.
sources.offline_assessment: The explicit no-submit payload branch could support a faithful standard-library JSON task after review of the matching public starter, guide and bounded inputs. That branch must not count as a real retrieval, generated video, readiness check or monitored deployment. Actual remote workflow operations and media generation are unavailable in the current isolated CPU runtime. Public examples are not assumed present. Missing runtime prerequisites are not permanent source exclusions.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: For a frozen payload-only task, compare actual saved JSON with the unchanged starter and reviewed release contract, requested storage mapping, unique collection and generation settings. Verify that no live submission is claimed. Real-run evaluation also needs retained run identity, terminal workflow state, actual retrieved and generated artifacts, validation and rejection manifests, and visual review for requested scene edits. Workflow success or plausibility alone does not establish that an accepted video exists or preserves the requested scene.

sources.workflow: Inspect the actual codebase and prior specifications read-only, distinguish implementation facts from intended behavior, conduct a mandatory user interview, present a complete fourteen-section draft, resolve a concrete Role, and hand the confirmed structured conversation to the separate writer. This source does not itself write the file or authorize application changes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The source declares an offline dialogue-driven workflow with read-only filesystem discovery. It needs the actual bounded project or an explicitly greenfield context and real replies to at least three separate intent questions covering Purpose and Outcomes, Principles and Vision. Existing specifications and source can inform questions but cannot substitute for those replies. A concrete Role gates writer handoff. No GPU, cloud service, package installation or credential is inherently required. Linked writer and schema behavior require separate review.
sources.offline_assessment: Read-only project exploration and a real bounded interview can occur offline if a human participant and project snapshot are available. The current single execution-agent session does not itself supply an interactive human interview or a reviewed mechanism for collecting such replies. Fabricated user answers, a prefilled template, inferred vision or file-only schema compliance cannot stand for this requested workflow. A narrower preparation artifact would require explicit precollection selection and cannot silently replace the complete interview.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check retained project evidence and the actual ordered conversation for one question per message, at least three real replies, explicit intent provenance, a concrete Role, all required sections and honest unresolved fields. Verify that inferred implementation facts remain distinct from confirmed intent and that no application-change authority is implied. A structural parser cannot establish human agreement or that a user supplied a principle or vision.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
